channel.title: The Albert Lea Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Blue Devils defeated in final home game of season
item.description: Despite having three players in double figures, the Riverland Community College women’s basketball team was defeated in their final home game of the season on Monday night 69-43 to Minnesota State Community and Technical College of Fergus Falls.

item.title: A.L. grads recognized on Riverland girls’ team
item.description: Erin Boorsma and Alexis Jones, both 2024 graduates of Albert Lea High School, were honored Saturday on Sophomore Appreciation Day as members of the Riverland Community College women’s basketball game prior to their game on Feb. 14 against St. Cloud Community and Technical College.

item.title: Storage unit broken into and other reports
item.description: Police received a report at 8:14 a.m. Monday of a storage unit that was broken into at 301 Rezin Ave. sometime between Nov. 23 and Feb. 9. Multiple items were taken, including a lawn mower, a two-wheeled cart, a yellow wagon and three old cream milk cans.

item.title: Southern Minnesota Initiative Foundation seeking applications for Early Literacy Grants
item.description: Southern Minnesota Initiative Foundation (SMIF), in partnership with publishing companies Capstone and ABDO, is accepting applications for its Early Literacy Grant program.

item.title: My Point of View: DFL Party has room for all walks of life
item.description: Following up on my column four weeks ago, Peggy Bennett personally apologized to me for Brad Kramer calling me insulting names, and I appreciate that she acted in alignment with her gubernatorial campaign goals.

item.title: Ask a Trooper: Things to consider while making right-hand turns
item.description: Question: I took my driver’s training course many years ago. One thing I remember from my training is the steps that go into making a right-hand turn.

item.title: Sarah Stultz: It doesn’t take much to be kind to others
item.description: Every year it seems like I stumble across a social media post at the end of the day on National Random Acts of Kindness Day, wishing I had known about it earlier.

item.title: Al Batt: My wife thinks a car for her husband is a good trade
item.description: “How many miles do you have on your car?”

item.title: Editorial: FFA is a valuable resource for students
item.description: It’s a big few days for those students taking part in FFA across the nation next week.
